notes.title: We present to you: Other Tales' Tales! 🦎🪛🐚🦋/🕰️
notes.content:
Our first developer bundle! We're now a company that has made more than one game! It's been five years since the release of Tick Tock: A Tale for Two and we're still in awe about the reception you've given our very first game... Now Miniatures is out too! And we've put these two story-driven games in a discounted bundle for you: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46610/Other_Tales_Tales/

Other Tales' Tales consists of our strange worlds Miniatures and Tick Tock: A Tale for Two. The first is a single-player, short story collection told through the lense of children making sense of an adult world. The second is a two-player, co-op game where your communication skills are put to the test. They are both atmospheric, hand-drawn, point-and-click games with a touch of magic. 

We hope you find something to love in both!

~ The Others

notes.title: Announcement Celebration Sale
notes.content:
To celebrate the announcement of our new title, Miniatures, we are delighted to announce that our original two-person narrative adventure is now on sale. This nordic noir cross-platform game plunges you and a friend into the eerie world created by the clockmaker Amalie Ravn. You must escape by solving Amalie’s puzzles and searching for clues to the truth which haunts the town.

Experience the game in a race against time as you both use your wits to escape the dark world of clockwork wonders and eerie echoes of Tick Tock: A Tale for Two.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/790740/Tick_Tock_A_Tale_for_Two

Already played Tick Tock: A Tale for Two?

Then take a look at our new game, Miniatures, and add it to your wishlist to follow the development. Four mysterious stories are all told from children’s perspectives. When you find an old wooden box containing a toy lizard, a framed moth, a screwdriver and a seashell, you are immersed in dream-like worlds of sandcastles and nature taking over as the world shifts around you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures?utm_source=steam-ticktock&utm_campaign=announcement
[b]~ The Others[/b]

notes.title: New Game Announcement - Miniatures
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that our new title, Miniatures, is coming to Steam in 2024! 

In Miniatures, we invite players to immerse themselves in the mysterious worlds of four items, discovered in an old wooden box: a toy lizard, a framed moth, a screwdriver and a seashell. Each object holds a peculiar adventure with unique artwork and gameplay, all told from a different child’s perspective. 

Watch our teaser trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=JgzoiD6tr9I;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoyed Tick Tock: A Tale for Two, then you will recognise the same dedication to hand-drawn artwork, atmospheric soundscapes and experimental, story-driven gameplay. But this time, you will be embarking on these dreamlike, eerie adventures alone.

Go to the new store page and wishlist the title now to keep up-to-date with all the latest developments in the mysterious world of Miniatures.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures/?utm_source=steam-ticktock&utm_campaign=announcement

~ Other Tales Team

Our audio wizard Troels, our programmer genius Andy, our porting elf Shana, our producer extraordinaire Anne, our marketing marvels Grace and Miya, all our brilliant testers, all our awesome translators, Neonhive, Coffee Stain, and our friends and family! As winter and darkness approaches, enjoy the chilling atmosphere of Tick Tock: A Tale for Two inside the warmth and comfort of your home and find yourself transported to a magical, eerie place that rivals the mysteries of the grand, old forests of Japan and Sweden.

notes.title: Japanese and Swedish language update - out on the 5th of December!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/78a18d800484aa2e71e95cbe57e220c28fd53994.png[/img]

Brace yourself for the soon-to-come language update for Tick Tock: A Tale for Two! On the 5th of December, it will finally be possible to delve into the mysteries of this uncanny clock-world in Japanese as well as in Swedish. So whether you find yourself in the chilly, northern parts of Scandinavia or in the eastern islands of Asia, get ready for an intense co-op experience with your friends and loved ones.

Tick Tock: A Tale for Two will also be released on the Nintendo Switch on the very same date, so get ready for even more cross-play options!

~ Mira & Tanja

notes.title: IndieCade 2019 - Cooperative Design Winner! 🏆
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/082b7a3d906c183bfcc1bcf2aa24df7c62299bfa.jpg[/img]

We can’t believe we won an award for Cooperative Design at IndieCade! We are over the moon! 🌙 And look at that award with its cogwheel face!

This is what the jury had to say: “Creating an experience that compels two players to communicate and to learn to collaborate in new ways is a challenging and powerful craft. Tick Tock: A Tale for Two brings play to the space of communication and trust, leveraging information and level design to build compelling, cooperative interactions.” 

Thank you for the wonderful words jurors, and THANK YOU all for playing Tick Tock and sharing your experiences. We never thought that the prototype that started as a part of our master thesis would grow up to be this AWARD-WINNING adventurer. Also thanks to Kat who represented us at the festival ❤️

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/cea0c698d546d9a3eab653d917f34fa8f8e53a91.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/3a9468fc8d8125783225f893d03c97968dfb73c3.jpg[/img][/url]
Thanks for playing! 

~ Mira & Tanja

notes.title: Chinese Language Update! First Patch Notes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/96bbe003ccae89daa45698e470cfde171cbba4e8.gif[/img]

We are so excited that we have added Chinese as one of our in game languages and are so happy that our Chinese speaking players can delve into Tick Tock and experience the game in their native language 😍 Thank you for letting us know about some inaccuracies in the language format, we have now updated everything and hope that the game runs smooth for all our Chinese players 🤞 We are hoping to add more languages very soon. Watch this space! 

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] A brand new language UI to make room for some cool upcoming languages that are currently being tested
[*] More reactive UI interactions
[*] Fixed a bug where collectable items would remain after being used/not show up properly in the UI
[*] Fixed a bug when entering a building and the back button wouldn’t show up
[*] Fixed a bug where exiting and entering a room would delete some sprites
[*] Optimizing the game to prevent any remaining crashes - mostly dealing with memory issues here
[*] Fixed text formatting errors that occurred in certain translations
[*] Reworked Simplified Chinese translation + added Chinese logo of the game
[*] Small changes to German translation to fit the style
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Starting Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/a4c1d95da507df21e078352cfd87f76d6f087697.png[/img]

We are so excited to show you how far our game has come since we wrote our master thesis about narrative game design a few years ago and are thrilled to announce our Open Beta starting on December 10th! 

The Beta will give you a taste of Tick Tock: A Tale for Two and you will be able to play our first chapter way before it releases in Q1 2019! To take part in the beta, all you need to do is join our [url=https://discord.gg/othertales]Discord Server[/url], here you can get beta keys and connect to other players who are looking for a friend to play with. 

The beta takes place between December 10th and January 7th, 2019, and is exclusive to Steam and iOS. Don’t forget that the game will be cross-platform so you can connect with a friend via iOS while you play on Steam!

Keep an eye on the clock so you don’t miss it - after all, time is a fickle thing. 


More updates soon! Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/OtherTales]twitter[/url].
[b]~ Mira and Tanja, Other Tales ~[/b]

notes.title: EGX 2018 was awesome! Here's what the press thought...
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/1c86ef8b6e4308f6bcda8e69d66474d60fb23628.png[/img]

We are so happy to have been part of this years Leftfield Collection at EGX. It was such an honor to showcase Tick Tock next to so many other creative game developers, but most of all seeing you all enjoy Tick Tock: A Tale For Two with your friends and putting your co-operative skills to the test was an amazing experience! 

The EGX blues have hit us hard this time around and we are already looking forward to next time!

[h1]Here are some reviews from EGX:[/h1]
[i]“It's teasing stuff - the whole of the game has a sense that time is running out, with the sound of ticking clocks and organic-looking clock pieces and cogs, and there's a larger story going on too” [/i] - [url=https://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2018-09-24-egx-2018-best-games-from-the-show-floor]Eurogamer[/url]

[i]“There’s very few games out there that make you fist bump the air when you’ve figured something out. Tick Tock is one of those games!”[/i] - [url=http://fingerguns.net/egx/2018/09/24/egx-2018-hands-on-with-tick-tock-a-tale-for-two/]FingerGuns[/url]

[i]“Tick Tock: A Tale for Two was another stand out for me, but you do need a friend to play it with as its nifty asymmetric co-op puzzles can’t be solved alone.”[/i] -  [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2018/09/25/the-bestest-games-of-egx/]Rock Pager Shotgun[/url]

More updates soon! Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/othertales]twitter.[/url]
[b]~ Mira and Tanja, The Other Tales[/b]

notes.title: We're in The PAX 10 Indie Showcase!
notes.content:
We're so excited to let you all know that we'll be at PAX West this week as part of The PAX 10 indie showcase! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/2991a07f72af58e02c8aea5e7cdb2ad0b1021c67.jpg[/img]

Each year a group of 50 industry experts select the ten best indie games in regard to gameplay and overall fun-factor from those submitted. These top titles are then included in The PAX 10 showcase. We're so thrilled to have made the cut!

This is the first time we'll be showcasing at PAX so we're really excited to see how it's received. Because you can play Tick Tock cooperatively across platforms, we'll have a PC and Tablet set up on the show floor!

For those of you heading to PAX West this week, we'll be onstage with fellow indies from the showcase on Saturday at 7:30 PM. Find out more [url=http://west.paxsite.com/schedule/panel/pax-10-part-2]here[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/75f9ed92ead94fdff300ca3cd3aa1acbfe862719.png[/img]

We can't want to see some of you there and we'll make sure to share photos on [url=https://twitter.com/OtherTales]twitter[/url] and on here when we return.

See you there!
[h1]~Tanja and Mira[/h1]
